race.comment: BONEWOOD (4) has been thereabouts each time and now runs off an eight week break. Does have good fresh form so will likely settle midfield here and run you a race. The little claim will come in handy as well. Was a strong trial winner for good measure. NEXT STOP JUPITER (5) has done nothing wrong this whole campaign. She plants herself right with the leaders and gives her all. Does keep going up in weight though. SUJEED (1) will get back in the field but find the line. It will be a matter of how far off them he gets. PORT RIVER BILLIE (12) has not won for some time which is a concern. She is another who prefers to sit back so might be tough but goes best to start a prep. MY PEPPERJACK (11) could be some value only if for being an on pace runner if that is the pattern.
